rows.en: (Now, what should I buy in the Shibuya Area today?)

Heh, I scored another T-shirt today
that really makes my soul tremble.

(A T-shirt Luis-san likes, huh...
The designs on the T-shirts he buys are, well...)
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (Oh well, I'll keep shopping.)

(A T-shirt Luis-san likes, huh...
The designs on the T-shirts he buys are, well...)
(Oh well, I'll keep shopping.)

(I came to the artificial island, but there's
really no point in coming here alone...)

All riiight!
Hey, ocean! Watch me swim!!

(Whoa, Luis-san's amazing.
He's already swum way out there...)
rows.notes: Name plate says Luis in 4 of 6 uses, but the line is the player's inner monologue about Luis (brackets, -san); translated as the player's thought.

rows.en:
(Whoa, Luis-san's amazing.
He's already swum way out there...)

(Griffith Park in the evening
really does feel kind of melancholy...)

Your Nyan-Nyan Dance doesn't come close
to the sharpness of mine!
Go back and start over from scratch!

(Huh?! Was Luis-san having a Nyan-Nyan Dance
showdown with someone?!)

(I-I'm curious, but...
Luis-san's already gone home,
so I'll head home for today too.)

(But a Nyan-Nyan Dance showdown...?
What on earth...?)

(Griffith Park in the evening
really does feel kind of melancholy...)

(I-I'm curious, but...
Luis-san's already gone home,
so I'll head home for today too.)

(I came shopping at Folmo today,
and at times like this, I always...)
(Yep, I run into Luis-san.)

I'm gonna sing for you again today!
Listen to my sooong!!
rows.notes: Ore no uta o kike: the standard 'Listen to my song!' (Basara's catchphrase).

rows.en:
Another great gig full of passion today...
To be continued tomorrow!
See ya!

(There was hardly anyone in the audience
for Luis-san's songs, but...)
(Personally, I don't mind your songs, Luis-san.)
(Yep, I run into Luis-san.)
(Personally, I don't mind your songs, Luis-san.)

(I came to have some fun in Deep Akihabara today,
and at times like this, I always...)

(Yep, it's Luis-san.
Wait, what's he doing in front of the maid cafe?)
Goddammit!

I'm telling 'em I'll work at their maid cafe,
so why won't they hire me?!
This is why people with no passion...
(...I kind of get why they won't, though.)

Geez, with passion like mine,
waiting on customers hand and foot
would be a breeze...

(Luis-san would probably squeeze himself into
a maid outfit and do the job anyway...)

(Yep, it's Luis-san.
Wait, what's he doing in front of the maid cafe?)

(Luis-san would probably squeeze himself into
a maid outfit and do the job anyway...)

(Oops, I left something in the storeroom.
I'd better go get it before I forget...)
rows.notes: souko rendered 'storeroom' (a storage room the player can walk back to).

rows.en: Hm? Oh, if it isn't Fresh Boy.

L-Luis-san?!
What are you doing in a place like this?!

This place is just right for a nap,
so I use it every now and then.
(Luis-san really does whatever he likes...)

So, with that said,
I'm gonna catch a few more Z's.
Oh, good ni......
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word, as the Japanese (oyasumina...).

rows.en: Snoooore! Snoooore!

(He's asleep already?! You fall asleep way
too fast, Luis-san...)

(Hmm... Luis-san really is
one strange guy.)

(Oops, I left something in the storeroom.
I'd better go get it before I forget...)
Hm? Oh, if it isn't Fresh Girl.
(Luis-san really does whatever he likes...)

(Hmm... Luis-san really is
one strange guy.)

(Maybe I'll watch a movie today.
Let's see... What's showing right now...)

Dammit! It won't stop!
The sweat of my heart... keeps pouring
from my eyes without end!
(Y-you're bawling your eyes out, Luis-san...)

Tch! Me, of all people, crying at a movie...
Just how pure can my soul be?!
rows.notes: Luis's doubled 'ore no mai souru' (my my soul) smoothed to 'my soul'.

rows.en:
Dammit! I made a total fool of myself
in front of all these people...

(Oh, so you do have a sense of shame,
Luis-san...)

Heh, can't be helped.
Luis Fernando shall make a dashing exit...
(Ah, Luis-san ran away.)

(Luis-san really does stand out
wherever he goes...)

(Maybe I'll watch a movie today.
Let's see... What's showing right now...)
(Ah, Luis-san ran away.)

(Luis-san really does stand out
wherever he goes...)
